verdict.rationale: Snowflake Notebooks are a first-party, cell-based environment in Snowsight for Python, SQL, and Markdown. The docs describe writing SQL or Python and comparing results cell by cell against Snowflake data for exploratory analysis, and the newer Notebooks in Workspaces adds Jupyter compatibility. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of inline chart rendering within notebooks (the community visualization mention concerns Snowsight generally, not notebooks), and no independent hands-on corroboration of the notebook experience.
